 Schuylkill dignitaries Holden, Allen, die
 Tweet 
 Published November 15. 2026 08:53PM 
 by CHRIS PARKER TNEDITOR@tnonline.com 
 Schuylkill County has lost two former elected officials, State Rep. Bob Allen and Congressman Tim Holden, in as many days.
 Allen, 81, died on Nov. 14; Holden, 69, died on Nov. 15.
 Allen, Pottsville, R-125, served nine consecutive terms, from 1989 through 2006. He had been the youngest mayor of Pottsville ever elected, serving from 1976 to 1981. Allen’s wife of 52 years, Margaret, died on Sept.17.
 Holden, of St. Clair, D-6th and 17th districts, served as the county sheriff from 1985 through 1993. He served in the US
 A viewing for family and friends will be held from 5 to 7 p.m. on Wednesday, Nov. 18, at First United Methodist Church, Pottsville.
 A Celebration of Life Funeral Service will be held at 11 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 19, at First United Methodist Church, with Rev. John Wallace officiating. An additional viewing will be held from 9 a.m. until the time of services.
 Interment will follow at Charles Baber Cemetery, Pottsville.
 House of Representatives from 1993 through 2013. After leaving Congress, he was appointed to the Pennsylvania liquor control board, where he served from 2013 through 2024. His wife Gwen died in April.
